scanNote:
Bu — YAKUNIY test: 1-15-unitlarning HAMMASINI qamrab oladi. Boshqa nazorat testlari faqat ikkita unitni tekshiradi.

1-mashqning 3-bandida ikkinchi bo'sh joy uzun bosilgan ('No, I ................................. .'). Qisqa javob 'HAVEN'T' yetarli; 'HAVE NEVER BEEN THERE' ham to'g'ri.

1-mashqning 14-bandida ikkita bo'sh joy ikki qatorga bo'lingan: 'Yes, ......... / ......... once.' To'liq javob: 'Yes, I HAVE FLOWN once.'

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the missing words.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'sh joylarni tushib qolgan so'zlar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR (24 ta bo'sh joy):

   1  was ... Did
   2  wrong
   3  ever ... haven't
   4  What's
   5  already ... yet
   6  What's
   7  ago
   8  Take
   9  can't
  10  How long
  11  When
  12  How are you
  13  did you do
  14  I have ... flown
  15  Would you
  16  What time
  17  have ... got
  18  How tall
  19  How much
  20  How

⚠ 4, 6, 8, 10, 11, 12, 15, 16, 18, 19,
20-bandlar GAP BOShIDA turadi → BOSh HARF
bilan.


──── PRESENT PERFECT ↔ PAST SIMPLE ────

  Bu — YAKUNIY testning eng muhim mavzusi
  (Unit 15).

  ⚠ ANIQ VAQT bor → PAST SIMPLE:

     1  'There WAS a brilliant film on TV
         LAST MONDAY. DID you see it?'
     7  'She left an hour AGO.'
    11  'WHEN did you come here? — LAST
         FRIDAY.'
    13  'What DID YOU DO LAST SUNDAY? —
         I WENT to the theatre.'

  ⚠ VAQT AYTILMAGAN → PRESENT PERFECT:

     3  'Have you EVER been to India? —
         No, I HAVEN'T.'
     5  'He has ALREADY seen the Louvre but
         he hasn't seen Notre Dame YET.'
    10  'HOW LONG have you been here? —
         SINCE FRIDAY.'
    14  'Have you flown on Concorde? —
         Yes, I HAVE FLOWN once.'


⚠ 10 va 11-BANDLAR — KITOBNING NOZIK
TUZOG'I:

  10  'HOW LONG HAVE YOU BEEN here?'
      → javob 'SINCE Friday' (davomiylik)
      → PRESENT PERFECT

  11  'WHEN DID YOU COME here?'
      → javob 'LAST Friday' (aniq vaqt)
      → PAST SIMPLE

  Ikkalasi ham juma kuni haqida, lekin
  ZAMONLARI BOShQA!

     'How long ...?' → qancha VAQTDAN BERI
     'When ...?' → QAChON (aniq nuqta)

  ⚠ 'WHEN' bilan Present Perfect
  IShLATILMAYDI (Coursebook 114-bet,
  6-mashqning 5-bandi).


⚠ 5-BAND — 'ALREADY' va 'YET':

  'He has ALREADY seen the Louvre'
     ALREADY — TASDIQDA, have va V3
     ORASIDA

  'he hasn't seen Notre Dame YET'
     YET — INKOR va SAVOLDA, GAP OXIRIDA


──── SAVOL SO'ZLARI (Unit 1-6) ────

  Testda YETTI xil savol so'zi bor:

   4  'WHAT'S Stella's phone number?'
      → RAQAM
  12  'HOW ARE YOU, Mrs Murray?'
      → AHVOL
  16  'WHAT TIME do you usually get up?'
      → SOAT
  18  'HOW TALL are you? — About one metre
       sixty.'
      → BO'Y
  19  'HOW MUCH are these cassettes? —
       £13.45.'
      → NARX
  20  'HOW do you get to work? — By bus.'
      → USUL (transport)
  10  'HOW LONG have you been here?'
      → DAVOMIYLIK

  ⚠ 'HOW ...' oilasining to'liq ro'yxati:
     How old? (yosh)
     How tall? (bo'y)
     How much? (narx, sanalmaydigan miqdor)
     How many? (sanaladigan miqdor)
     How long? (davomiylik)
     How often? (chastota)
     How far? (masofa)
     How? (usul)


──── BOShQALAR ────

 2  'What's WRONG with this radio, Bob?'
    ⚠ 'What's wrong WITH ...?' — predlog
    'with' SHART.
    (7-nazorat testining 3-mashqi, 4-bandi
     ham shu.)

 6  'WHAT'S on TV tonight?'
    'What's on?' = nima ko'rsatilyapti?

 8  'He's very funny. Quick! TAKE some
     pictures.'
    BUYRUQ gap → asosiy shakl.
    'take pictures' = surat olmoq.

 9  'I'm afraid I CAN'T go to Sue's party.'
    ⚠ 'I'm afraid ...' — yomon xabarni
    muloyim aytish.

15  'We're going to the opera tonight.
     WOULD YOU like to come?'
    TAKLIF shakli.

17  'How many friends HAVE you GOT? — Ten.'
    'have got' savol shakli: HAVE + ega +
    GOT.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  brilliant  = ajoyib
  the Louvre = Luvr (Parij muzeyi)
  Notre Dame = Notr-Dam (Parij sobori)
  Concorde   = Konkord (o'ta tez samolyot)
  to fly (flown) = uchmoq
  an opera   = opera
  a cassette = kasseta
  a metre    = metr

items.sentence: 1  There ..................................... a brilliant film on TV last Monday.   (birinchi bo'sh joy)
items.uz: O'tgan dushanba televizorda ajoyib film bor edi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'LAST MONDAY' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

'a film' — BIRLIK → WAS ('There WAS').

O'TMISH haqida savol → DID.

⚠ 'did' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'Did you SEE it?'  ✓
  'Did you SAW it?'  ✗

items.sentence: 2  'What's ............................. with this radio, Bob?'  'I don't know.'

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'What's WRONG WITH ...?' — predlog 'with'
SHART.

7-nazorat testining 3-mashqi, 4-bandi ham shu:
'What's wrong with you, Doug?'

Coursebook 112-bet: 'What's WRONG with this
car, David?'

items.sentence: 3  'Have you ..................................... been to India?'   (birinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'EVER' — faqat SAVOLDA.

'Have you EVER been ...?' = hech qachon
borganmisiz?

Tasdiq shaklda inkor ma'no → 'NEVER'
('I have NEVER been').

QISQA JAVOB: savoldagi yordamchi fe'l
takrorlanadi.

'HAVE you ...?' → 'No, I HAVEN'T.'

⚠ 'HAVE NEVER BEEN THERE' ham to'g'ri
(kitobda bo'sh joy uzun bosilgan).

KALIT: javob RAQAM → 'WHAT'S ...?'

1-nazorat testining 3-mashqi ham shu:
'What's your phone number?'

'Stella'S' — egalik shakli.

items.sentence: 5  He has ..................................... seen the Louvre   (birinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'ALREADY' — TASDIQDA, 'have' va V3
ORASIDA:
  'He has ALREADY SEEN.'  ✓
  'He has seen already.'  ✗ (kuchsizroq)

Unit 15 grammatikasi.

items.sentence: 5  but he hasn't seen Notre Dame ..................................... .   (ikkinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'YET' — INKOR va SAVOLDA, GAP OXIRIDA:
  'he hasn't seen it YET'  ✓
  'he hasn't yet seen it' — rasmiyroq

ALREADY (tasdiq) ↔ YET (inkor/savol) — bir
gapda ikkalasi!

'WHAT'S ON?' = nima ko'rsatilyapti?
(turg'un savol)

4-nazorat testi: 'there's a great concert ON'
— bir xil 'on'.

⚠ 'AGO' — o'lchovdan KEYIN, GAP OXIRIDA:
  'an hour AGO'  ✓
  'ago an hour'  ✗

DOIM Past Simple bilan ('She LEFT' ✓).
leave → LEFT → left.

items.sentence: 8  He's very funny. Quick! ................ some pictures.
items.uz: U juda kulgili. Tez! Bir necha surat oling.

commonMistake.whyUz:
BUYRUQ GAP → ASOSIY shakl, EGA YO'Q.

'TAKE pictures' = surat olmoq.

Coursebook 113-bet: 'David asks Sandra TO
TAKE some pictures.'

⚠ 'I'M AFRAID ...' — yomon xabarni MULOYIM
aytish.

Keyin odatda inkor: 'I'm afraid I CAN'T ...'

7-nazorat testi: 'I'd love to, but I CAN'T.'

⚠ KALIT: javob 'SINCE Friday' — DAVOMIYLIK
→ 'HOW LONG ... HAVE ...?' (Present Perfect).

11-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda 'LAST
Friday' (aniq vaqt) → Past Simple!

Kitobning nozik tuzog'i.

⚠ KALIT: javob 'LAST Friday' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

⚠ 'WHEN' bilan Present Perfect ISHLATILMAYDI!
(Coursebook 114-bet, 6-mashq, 5-band)

10-band bilan yonma-yon solishtiring.

KALIT: javob 'VERY WELL, thanks' — AHVOL.

'How are you?' — 1, 2 va 6-nazorat
testlarida ham uchragan.

items.sentence: 13  'What ..................................... last Sunday?'  'I went to the theatre.'

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'LAST SUNDAY' + javob 'I WENT'
→ PAST SIMPLE.

⚠ IKKI 'do': 'What DID YOU DO?'
  'did' — yordamchi
  'do' — asosiy fe'l

items.sentence: 14  'Have you flown on Concorde?'  'Yes, ..................'   (birinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
QISQA JAVOB: 'HAVE you ...?' → 'Yes, I HAVE.'

Javobdagi yordamchi fe'l savoldagi bilan bir
xil.

PRESENT PERFECT → V3.

fly → flew → FLOWN (noto'g'ri fe'l).

To'liq javob: 'Yes, I HAVE FLOWN once.'
'once' = bir marta (tajriba).

items.sentence: 15  We're going to the opera tonight. ..................................... like to come?
items.uz: Bugun kechqurun operaga boramiz. Siz ham kelasizmi?

commonMistake.whyUz:
TAKLIF → 'WOULD YOU LIKE TO ...?'

'like to come' allaqachon bosilgan, demak
'Would you' kerak.

7-nazorat testining 11-bandi ham shu.

items.sentence: 16  '..................... do you usually get up?'  '7 o'clock.'

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: javob SOAT ('7 o'clock')
→ 'WHAT TIME ...?'

'usually' — Present Simple ko'rsatkichi
(doimiy odat).

'have got' savol shakli: HAVE + ega + GOT.

'you' → HAVE ('has' emas).

'How MANY friends' — sanaladigan ko'plik.

items.sentence: 17  How many friends have you ..................... ?'  'Ten.'   (ikkinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
'have GOT' — Britaniya inglizchasida egalik
shakli.

Amerikada shunchaki 'How many friends DO you
HAVE?'

KALIT: javob BO'Y ('one metre sixty')
→ 'HOW TALL ...?'

⚠ 'How tall ARE you?' — 'be' bilan
('How tall HAVE you?' XATO).

'How high?' — bino, tog' uchun.

KALIT: javob NARX ('£13.45') → 'HOW MUCH ...?'

⚠ 'How much' — narx uchun ham, sanalmaydigan
miqdor uchun ham.

'these cassettes' — ko'plik → ARE.

KALIT: javob USUL ('By bus') → 'HOW ...?'

'get to work' = ishga yetib bormoq.
'BY bus' — artiklsiz (by car, by train).

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  A ever
   2  B ridden
   3  A waste
   4  B book
   5  C with
   6  A since
   7  A stand
   8  B since
   9  C earth
  10  B just


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'It's the tallest building we've EVER
     seen.'
    ⚠ USTUN DARAJA + 'we've EVER seen' —
    turg'un qurilma.
       'the best film I've EVER seen'
       'the tallest building we've EVER
        seen'
    'never' — ikki inkor bo'lardi.
    'just' — 'hozirgina', mantiqsiz.

 2  'I have never RIDDEN a camel.'
    ⚠ 'RIDE a camel' = tuya minmoq.
    ride → rode → RIDDEN (V3).
    'driven a camel' — mashinada haydash
       (mantiqsiz).
    'walked a camel' — tuyani yetaklash
       (g'alati).

    (Coursebook 104-bet: 'I even RODE a
     camel.')

 3  'Don't WASTE your time.'
    ⚠ 'WASTE time/money' = bekorga sarflamoq.
    'SPEND time' = vaqt o'tkazmoq (neytral),
       lekin 'Don't spend your time' — chala
       gap.
    'eat your time' — mavjud emas.

 4  'I'd like to BOOK a table for tonight.'
    ⚠ 'BOOK a table' = stol band qilmoq.
    (4-nazorat testining 2-mashqi, 4-bandi
     ham AYNAN shu edi!)

 5  'John is staying WITH his friend, Tom.'
    ⚠ 'stay WITH somebody' = kimnikida
    turmoq.
    'stay AT a hotel' = mehmonxonada turmoq
       (JOY bilan 'at').
    'stay in' — 'uyda qolmoq' (boshqa ma'no).

    (Coursebook 115-bet: 'I am STAYING WITH
     my Uncle Douglas.')

 6  'They've been here SINCE Monday.'
    ⚠ 'Monday' — NUQTA (qachondan) → SINCE.
    'for Monday' — XATO.
    'until Monday' — 'dushanbagacha' (boshqa
       ma'no, va Present Perfect bilan
       g'alati).

 7  'I can't STAND this music. It's
     horrible.'
    ⚠ 'can't STAND something' = chiday
    olmaslik, yomon ko'rmoq.
    KALIT: 'It's HORRIBLE' — salbiy baho.
    'can't have' / 'can't take' — bu ma'noni
       bermaydi.

 8  'She has been here SINCE last year.'
    ⚠ 'last year' — BOShLANISh NUQTASI
    → SINCE.
    'for last year' — XATO.

    ⚠ 6 va 8-bandlar bir xil qoida:
       SINCE + nuqta (Monday, last year,
          1989, May)
       FOR + davomiylik (two days, a month,
          ten years)

 9  'What on EARTH is going on?'
    ⚠ 'What on EARTH ...?' = nima balo
    bo'lyapti?! (hayrat/g'azabni
    kuchaytiruvchi turg'un ibora).
    'what on matter' / 'what on top' —
       mavjud emas.

10  'They have JUST packed their suitcases.'
    ⚠ 'JUST' — TASDIQDA, 'have' va V3
    ORASIDA.
    'yet' — inkor/savolda, gap oxirida.
    'ever' — savolda.


⚠ TESTNING ENG MUHIM QOIDASI —
'SINCE' va 'FOR' (6 va 8-bandlar):

  SINCE + BOShLANISh NUQTASI:
     since Monday, since last year,
     since 1989, since May, since I was born

  FOR + DAVOMIYLIK:
     for two days, for a month,
     for ten years, for ages


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to waste   = bekorga sarflamoq
  to stay with = kimnikida turmoq
  can't stand = chiday olmaslik
  horrible   = dahshatli
  What on earth ...? = Nima balo ...?
  to pack    = yig'ishtirmoq (jomadon)
  a suitcase = jomadon

exercises.explanationUz:
BEShTA DIALOG — SAVOLNI TOPISh KERAK.

⚠ Har bandda savolning OXIRI allaqachon
bosilgan.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  A: 'WHERE'S YOUR mother?'
    B: 'She's at work.'

 2  A: 'CAN YOU CLOSE THE window? It's very
        cold.'
    B: 'Of course.'

 3  A: 'WHAT DAY IS IT today?'
    B: 'Monday.'

 4  A: 'WHAT'S WRONG WITH YOUR car, Claire?'
    B: 'I can't start it.'

 5  A: 'WHAT TIME DOES THE film start?'
    B: 'It starts at two o'clock.'


QANDAY TOPILADI:

 1  Bosilgan: '... mother?'
    Javob: 'She's AT WORK.' — JOY.
    → 'Where's your mother?'

 2  Bosilgan: '... window?' + 'It's very
    cold.'
    Javob: 'Of course.' — ILTIMOSGA javob.
    Sovuq → derazani YOPISh kerak.
    → 'Can you close the window?'

    ⚠ 'Could you close ...?' ham to'g'ri.

 3  Bosilgan: '... today?'
    Javob: 'Monday.' — HAFTA KUNI.
    → 'What day is it today?'

    ⚠ 'What's the date today?' bo'lsa javob
    sana bo'lardi ('The 5th of May').

 4  Bosilgan: '... car, Claire?'
    Javob: 'I CAN'T START it.' — muammo.
    → 'What's wrong with your car?'

    ⚠ 1-mashqning 2-bandi AYNAN shu qurilma:
    'What's WRONG WITH this radio, Bob?'

 5  Bosilgan: '... film start?'
    Javob: 'It STARTS at two o'clock.' —
    SOAT.
    → 'What time does the film start?'

    ⚠ 'does' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
       'does the film START'  ✓
       'does the film STARTS' ✗


⚠ 2-BAND — SABAB JAVOBDAN KEYIN EMAS,
SAVOLDAN KEYIN:

  Kitobda 'It's very cold.' A ning gapida,
  savoldan KEYIN turadi:

     A: 'Can you close the window? It's very
         cold.'
     B: 'Of course.'

  Ya'ni A avval iltimos qiladi, keyin
  sababini aytadi.


⚠ 3-BAND — 'WHAT DAY' va 'WHAT'S THE DATE'
FARQI:

  'What DAY is it today?' → Monday
     (hafta kuni)
  'What's the DATE today?' → The 5th of May
     (sana)


DIQQAT — 'AT WORK':
  'She's AT WORK.' — artiklsiz turg'un
  ibora.

  2-nazorat testi: 'My father is AT work.'


DIQQAT — 'OF COURSE':
  'Of course.' = albatta.
  Iltimosga muloyim rozilik.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  at work    = ishda
  to close   = yopmoq
  Of course  = albatta
  What day is it? = Bugun hafta kunining
               qaysi kuni?
  to start   = boshlanmoq

patterns.formula: HOW LONG HAVE + [ega] + BEEN ... ?  —  SINCE [nuqta].   ↔   WHEN DID + [ega] + [ASOSIY fe'l]?  —  LAST [vaqt].
patterns.exampleEn: How long have you been here? — Since Friday.  /  When did you come here? — Last Friday.

BOSHQA!

patterns.exampleEn: He has already seen the Louvre but he hasn't seen Notre Dame yet.
patterns.exampleUz: U Luvrni allaqachon ko'rgan, lekin Notr-Damni hali ko'rmagan.
patterns.explanationUz:
ALREADY — tasdiqda, have va V3 orasida;
YET — inkorda, gap oxirida.

patterns.exampleEn: They've been here since Monday. She has been here since last year.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular dushanbadan beri shu yerda. U o'tgan yildan beri shu yerda.
patterns.explanationUz:
SINCE + nuqta (Monday, last year, 1989);
FOR + davomiylik (two days, a month).

patterns.exampleEn: It's the tallest building we've ever seen.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu biz ko'rgan eng baland bino.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ustun daraja + Present Perfect + EVER —
turg'un qurilma.

patterns.exampleEn: What's wrong with this radio, Bob? What's wrong with your car, Claire?
patterns.exampleUz: Bu radioga nima bo'ldi, Bob? Mashinangizga nima bo'ldi, Kler?
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Predlog 'WITH' SHART.
Testda IKKI marta tekshirilgan.

patterns.formula: What time DOES + [ega] + [ASOSIY fe'l]?  —  It [fe'l]S at [soat].
patterns.exampleEn: What time does the film start? — It starts at two o'clock.
patterns.exampleUz: Film soat nechchida boshlanadi? — Soat ikkida.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'does' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl;
javobda '-S' qo'shiladi.
